defmodule AutonomousResearchAgent do
  use Application
  require Logger
  @moduledoc false

  def start(_type, _args) do
    children = [
      {Plug.Cowboy, scheme: :http, plug: AutonomousResearchAgent.Router, options: [port: 5000]}
    ]

    opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: AutonomousResearchAgent.Supervisor]
    Supervisor.start_link(children, opts)
  end
end

defmodule AutonomousResearchAgent.Router do
  import Plug.Conn
  use Plug.Router
  alias AutonomousResearchAgent.Util
  alias AutonomousResearchAgent.JobRegistry
  alias AutonomousResearchAgent.AIAdapters
  alias AutonomousResearchAgent.ResearchCoordinator
  alias AutonomousResearchAgent.JobRunner

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json, :multipart], json_decoder: Phoenix.json_library()
  plug CORSPlug, origin: "*"
  plug :dispatch

  post "/query" do
    {:ok, body, _conn} = Plug.Conn.read_body(conn)
    %{"mode" => mode, "prompt" => prompt, "time_limit_minutes" => time_limit, "max_sources" => max_sources, "attached_files" => files} = Jason.decode!(body)
    job_id = :crypto.hash(:md5, "#{prompt}#{:os.system_time(:millisecond)}") |> Base.encode16() |> String.slice(0, 16)
    job = JobRegistry.new_job(job_id, mode, prompt, time_limit, max_sources, files)
    JobRegistry.register(job)

    cond do
      Enum.count(files) > 0 or mode == "kutatas" ->
        JobRunner.run_enhanced(job)
      mode == "sima" ->
        JobRunner.run_simple(job)
      mode == "autonom" ->
        JobRunner.run_autonomous(job)
      true ->
        JobRunner.run_research(job)
    end

    send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{job_id: job_id, status: "created", mode: mode}))
  end

  get "/status/:job_id" do
    job = JobRegistry.get(job_id)
    send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(job))
  end

  get "/report/:job_id" do
    job = JobRegistry.get(job_id)
    send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{report: job.report}))
  end

  get "/health" do
    send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{
      status: "healthy",
      version: "2.0.0",
      timestamp: DateTime.utc_now(),
      active_jobs: JobRegistry.active_jobs_count()
    }))
  end

  get _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "Not Found")
  end
end

defmodule AutonomousResearchAgent.Util do
  def clean_text(nil), do: ""
  def clean_text(text) do
    text
    |> String.replace("\\u201c", "\"")
    |> String.replace("\\u201d", "\"")
    |> String.replace("\\u2018", "'")
    |> String.replace("\\u2019", "'")
    |> String.replace("\\u2013", "-")
    |> String.replace("\\u2014", "-")
    |> String.replace("\\u2026", "...")
    |> String.replace("\\u00a0", " ")
  end
end

defmodule AutonomousResearchAgent.JobRegistry do
  use Agent
  alias AutonomousResearchAgent.JobState

  def start_link(_opts) do
    Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def new_job(job_id, mode, prompt, time_limit, max_sources, files) do
    %JobState{
      job_id: job_id,
      status: "pending",
      mode: mode,
      prompt: prompt,
      created_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601(),
      updated_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601(),
      progress: 0.0,
      time_limit_minutes: time_limit,
      max_sources: max_sources,
      attached_files: files
    }
  end

  def register(job), do: Agent.update(__MODULE__, &Map.put(&1, job.job_id, job))
  def get(job_id), do: Agent.get(__MODULE__, &Map.get(&1, job_id))
  def update(job_id, updates), do: Agent.update(__MODULE__, &Map.update!(&1, job_id, fn j -> Map.merge(j, updates) end))
  def active_jobs_count(), do: Agent.get(__MODULE__, &Enum.count(&1, fn {_id, j} -> j.status == "running" end))
end

defmodule AutonomousResearchAgent.JobState do
  defstruct [
    :job_id,
    :status,
    :mode,
    :prompt,
    :created_at,
    :updated_at,
    :progress,
    :time_limit_minutes,
    :max_sources,
    :attached_files,
    :report,
    :error,
    sources: [],
    action_logs: []
  ]
end

defmodule AutonomousResearchAgent.AIAdapters do
  defmodule Exa do
    def search(query, num_results) do
      %{query: query, sources: Enum.map(1..num_results, fn i -> %{url: "", title: "Forrás #{i}"} end)}
    end
  end
  defmodule GPT5 do
    def synthesize(prompt, context), do: %{synthesis: "Generated report for #{prompt} with context #{String.slice(context,0,100)}"}
  end
  defmodule Grok do
    def verify(claim, _sources), do: %{verified: true, confidence: 0.9, summary: "Claim verified: #{claim}"}
  end
end

defmodule AutonomousResearchAgent.ResearchCoordinator do
  alias AutonomousResearchAgent.AIAdapters.{Exa, GPT5, Grok}
  alias AutonomousResearchAgent.Util
  alias AutonomousResearchAgent.JobRegistry

  def execute_simple(job) do
    Exa.search(job.prompt, 100)
    |> handle_results(job)
  end

  defp handle_results(%{sources: sources}, job) do
    synthesis = GPT5.synthesize(job.prompt, Enum.map_join(sources, "\n", & &1.title))
    verification = Enum.map(sources, &Grok.verify(&1.title, sources))
    report = %{
      question: job.prompt,
      sources_count: length(sources),
      verified: Enum.count(verification, & &1.verified)
    }
    JobRegistry.update(job.job_id, %{status: "completed", progress: 1.0, report: Jason.encode!(report)})
  end
end

defmodule AutonomousResearchAgent.JobRunner do
  def run_simple(job), do: Task.start(fn -> AutonomousResearchAgent.ResearchCoordinator.execute_simple(job) end)
  def run_research(job), do: Task.start(fn -> AutonomousResearchAgent.ResearchCoordinator.execute_simple(job) end)
  def run_enhanced(job), do: Task.start(fn -> AutonomousResearchAgent.ResearchCoordinator.execute_simple(job) end)
  def run_autonomous(job), do: Task.start(fn -> AutonomousResearchAgent.ResearchCoordinator.execute_simple(job) end)
end
